name: bigquery
description: Google BigQuery: datasets, tables and schemas, parameterised GoogleSQL queries with a bytes-billed cap, dry runs and paged results; agent tools run SELECT only

nodes.title: List datasets
nodes.description: List the datasets of a project

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: List tables
nodes.description: List the tables and views of a dataset

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Get table schema
nodes.description: Get a table's schema (nested fields flattened), row and byte counts, partitioning and clustering

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Run query
nodes.description: Run one GoogleSQL query with @named or ? parameters; returns typed rows and next_cursor. Every query is capped by maximum_bytes_billed (at most BIGQUERY_MAX_BYTES_BILLED); dry_run estimates bytes for free. As an agent tool only SELECT runs unless BIGQUERY_TOOL_ALLOW_WRITES=1

sql.description: GoogleSQL, e.g. SELECT name, total FROM shop.orders WHERE created >= @since LIMIT 100

params.description: Named params as an object ({"since": "2026-11-01"}) or positional as an array; typed values as {"type": "DATE", "value": "2026-11-01"}

dry_run.description: Only validate and estimate bytes processed (free)

maximum_bytes_billed.description: Bytes-billed limit for this query (default and maximum BIGQUERY_MAX_BYTES_BILLED)

default_dataset.description: Dataset for unqualified table names: dataset or project.dataset

location.description: Job location, e.g. US, EU, asia-southeast1 (default BIGQUERY_LOCATION)

max_rows.description: Maximum rows in this page (also capped by BIGQUERY_MAX_RESULT_BYTES)

wait_ms.description: How long to wait for the query to finish (default BIGQUERY_QUERY_TIMEOUT_MS)

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.description: Next page of a query's rows (or wait for a query that was still running), from a query's next_cursor

access_token.description: Overrides the plugin's default token for this node (use a secret; needs --trust-plugin)
